dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project was to compile baseline data on age, body condition, and the parasite and disease status of caribou as part of a larger program within the CircumArctic Rangifer Monitoring and Assessment (CARMA) Network to study herds across the circumpolar region using the Rangifer Health and Body Condition monitoring protocols to ensure that the information is comparable to data collected in subsequent years and in different herds of caribou and reindeer in the circumpolar region.
dct_subject_sm: Natural sciences -> Bluenose West caribou herd
dct_title_s: Harvested Bluenose West Caribou Herd Health Monitoring in the Northwest Territories, Canada
